bridge.title: Tally bridge checklist
bridge.s1: Owner picks the import computer: an office PC or a Windows machine in India with a TallyPrime licence.
bridge.s2: Admin deploys the tally-bridge Edge Function (Mumbai) and gives the bridge its own device key — never the Supabase secret key.
bridge.s3: The bridge downloads the stored backup and restores it in TallyPrime into its own data folder, never over the live Tally.
bridge.s4: In TallyPrime, switch on the XML/HTTP server on port 9000 (F1 → Settings → Advanced Configuration) and open the restored company.
bridge.s5: The bridge reads masters and vouchers through port 9000 and sends the rows to this batch.
bridge.s6: The batch shows “Read”. Press “Check and load” in the history below; differences go to the Bug fixer.
bridge.owner: Open question for the owner: which computer is the import computer.

template.title: Template columns
template.products: Products: name (required), item code, group, unit, HSN, MRP.
template.parties: Parties: name (required), GSTIN, PAN, phone or WhatsApp, address, group, opening balance.
template.employees: Employees: name (required), employee code, PAN, mobile, date of birth, Aadhaar (only the last 4 digits are kept).
template.synonyms: Common names are understood, e.g. “Party name”, “GST No”, “Mobile”, “HSN/SAC”, “UOM”. Unknown columns are ignored.
template.tally: From Tally: in TallyPrime export masters (groups, ledgers, stock items, units, godowns) and the day book as XML, then upload each file here.

history.title: Import history
history.caption: Import batches
history.empty: No imports yet. Each batch will appear here with its rows, user and time, and can be undone until it is approved.
history.approveEffect: Approving locks batch {{code}}: it can no longer be undone. Records it created stay “to review” until checked.
history.undoDescription: Removes the records this batch created that are still “to review” and closes its open Bug fixer items. Linked records are kept. This is logged.
history.errReason: Say why, in at least 5 characters.
